metadata.question: Did Cambodia have more active fire during February than October from 2014 to 2017?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use MODIS or VIIRS fire products (e.g., MODIS/006/MOD14A1 or FIRMS) - Compare February vs October for years 2014-2017 - Location: Cambodia country boundary 2. Masking strategy: - Fire products typically have confidence bands - should filter for high confidence fires - The question is specifically about active fires, so we need the fire mask/detection bands 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Valid Zero: Fire count of 0 is valid (means no fires detected) - Check collection size first (C1 if no images) - Check if results are None/null (C3) - Compare February total vs October total across all years ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const cambodia = ee.FeatureCollection('USDOS/LSIB_SIMPLE/2017') .filter(ee.Filter.eq('country_na', 'Cambodia')) .geometry(); // 2. Data Acquisition for February (2014-2017) const febCol = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD14A1') .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(2014, 2017, 'year')) .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(2, 2, 'month')) .select('FireMask'); const febSize = febCol.size().getInfo(); console.log('February Images:', febSize); if (febSize === 0) { console.log('No data for February 2014-2017.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 3. Data Acquisition for October (2014-2017) const octCol = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD14A1') .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(2014, 2017, 'year')) .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(10, 10, 'month')) .select('FireMask'); const octSize = octCol.size().getInfo(); console.log('October Images:', octSize); if (octSize === 0) { console.log('No data for October 2014-2017.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 4. Processing - Count fire pixels (FireMask > 0 indicates fire) const countFires = function(collection) { const fireImage = collection.map(function(img) { return img.gt(0); }).sum(); const stats = fireImage.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: cambodia, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); return stats.get('FireMask'); }; const febFires = countFires(febCol).getInfo(); const octFires = countFires(octCol).getInfo(); console.log('February Fire Detections:', febFires); console.log('October Fire Detections:', octFires); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (febFires === null || octFires === null) { console.log('Calculation failed - null result'); console.log('C3'); return; } if (febFires === 0 && octFires === 0) { console.log('Valid result: No fires detected in either period'); console.log('B'); return; } console.log('Comparison: Feb=' + febFires + ' vs Oct=' + octFires); if (febFires > octFires) { console.log('February had more active fires than October'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('February did not have more active fires than October'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
